Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application is disposed of.

This petition has been filed for quashing for FIR No. 508/2022 registered at PS Bhajan Pura,
Delhi under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC on the ground that the parties have settled their disputes dated 24.12.2022 arrived at with the facilitation with the Counselling Cell, Family Courts, North East District Karkardooma Courts, which is on record of this Court.

sentences.text: Petitioner No. 1-3 and respondent No. 2 (complainant) are present in Court and are This is a digitally signed order.

The presence of the other petitioners is exempted on the oral request of the counsel for the petitioner.

2. As per settlement balance amount of Rs. 02 Lacs is being tendered by DD No. 057651 drawn on Bank Jamia Co-operative Bank Ltd. dated 29.05.2023 to the respondent No. 2 who has duly received it and acknowledged.

sentences.text: Petitioner No. 1 and respondent No. 2 were married on 28.10.2020 but due to disputes and differences the marriage ended in a divorce by pronouncement of (Talaq E Mubarat)
which is also on record of this Court.
No child was born out of wedlock.
4. Respondent No.2 further states that no further amount are to be received and she has no objection to the quashing of the said FIR.

5. Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State exchequer.
Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
Consequently, the FIR No. 508/2022 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Bhajan Pura, Delhi and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
6. Parties shall abide by the terms of settlement.
7. Accordingly, the petition is disposed of.
Pending applications (if any) are disposed of as infructuous.
8. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
ANISH DAYAL, J MAY 31, 2023/RK
